Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the first place mentioned in the Book of Esther (New International Version). The first verse of the book states, "In the days of Ahasuerus, a mighty man who reigned over all the kingdom from India to Ethiopia..." The first proper noun (place) mentioned is **India** (or "India to Ethiopia" as a range, but India is the specific location named first). The agent incorrectly assumed the first place was Susa, which is actually mentioned much later in the text (Chapter 1, Verse 2). This factual error in the initial lookup led to the entire subsequent reasoning chain being based on the wrong location, resulting in an incorrect answer (Amir-Abbas Hoveyda of Iran) instead of the Prime Minister of India in April 1977 (Morarji Desai).
